The automated factory designed to make Mars livable
This is what industry on another planet actually looks like
caption:
Getting to Mars is the easy part. Surviving once you land is the problem.

To build a permanent base you need tools, parts, and structures made on-site, because shipping everything from Earth takes nine months and costs more than any government can sustain. Terafab is the concept for a large-scale automated factory that lands before the humans do, mines local Martian materials, and manufactures what the colony needs to grow without waiting for the next resupply window.
